reference.title: AT+HTTPCONTENT
reference.shortdesc: This command is used to set or query HTTP content information.

row.entry:
If succeed
If only the id parameter field is entered and the current content is empty, the following is returned: OKOtherwise, the previously entered content information will be returned: +HTTPCONTENT:<id>,<length> <content> OKIf the formats of id and content are correct, the information is set successfully and the following is returned: OK If failERROR
This command is used to set or query HTTP content information.
<id>Integer. The instance index returned by +HTTPCREATE. Range: 0~4. M5310-E/MN328-B range: 0~1.

<content>String. The content information to be configured. MN316A value range: 0~2048. Unit: byte. When <content> is empty and <encode_method> is 0, the module enters data mode. Data input is terminated when the input length reaches 2048 bytes, or when CTRL+Z is sent, or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs.
<encode_method>Integer. Parsed as string or hexadecimal. When it is string, escape characters are supported. In MN316A data mode, only the value 0, which is plain string is supported.

<len>Integer. Specify the length of input data in data mode. Range: 0~2048. When the length is entered, the module enters data mode.<header> and <encode_method> may be omitted or set to an invalid value. When <len> is set to 0, data input is terminated when the input length reaches 2048 bytes, or when CTRL+Z is sent, or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs; When <len> is set to a value greater than 0, data input is terminated when the specified length is reached or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs. MN316A does not support this parameter.
<length> Return the length of the entered content.

p.note: The usage of +HTTPCONTENT is similar to that of +HTTPHEADER, and will not be elaborated.
